question: In January 2022, who became India’s first UNDP youth climate champion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prajakta Koli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In January 2022, **Prajakta Koli** became India’s first UNDP Youth Climate Champion.
 
• Prajakta Koli is a popular Indian content creator, actress, and well-known for her YouTube channel, **"MostlySane,**"
 
• **UNDP was founded in 1965** as part of the United Nations system.
 
• The headquarters of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is located in **New York City, United States.**
